description.value: The Cache Creek Library is a branch of the Thompson-Nicola Regional Library System, housed in a 2013-built, 1,672-square-foot building located directly on the Trans-Canada Highway. It is part of one of the larger regional library networks in British Columbia's interior, serving the small community of Cache Creek. For touring cyclists passing through this otherwise sparse stretch of highway, it offers free Wi-Fi and public computers as a rest-stop resource.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Wi-Fi as a listed service under 'Services', corroborating the OSM internet_access=wlan and internet_access:fee=no tags. Phone number (250-457-9953) and physical address (1025 Trans Canada Hwy, Cache Creek, BC V0K 1H0) on the website match the OSM record. The website lists only four services — Wi-Fi, Wheelchair accessible, Public Computers, Printing/Photocopying — and makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill, so those required criteria cannot be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Cache Creek sits on a major Trans-Canada cycling corridor and the library could be a useful stop, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from the website. A site visit or direct inquiry would be needed to determine whether it meets the WWC minimum threshold.
